scenarios.name: Filter drawing browser entries while retaining their parent branches

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with border entries in its resources and sheet
the drawing browser branches are expanded
the user opens the drawing browser search field
matching border entries are displayed beneath their respective parent branches
the user clears the search text
the unfiltered drawing browser tree is displayed
the user closes the empty search field
